terra.problem: The passage does not say David had no palace or crowd, or that this was a good day for him.
Being able to use both hands does not establish that none of the archers had a weaker side.
The oven mitt and spatula comparison does not clearly match the shield and spear: a spatula is not normally used to poke.
Matching crumbs has no clear connection to being a match for men in battle, so the joke does not click.
The river overflowed its banks, but the text does not say whether it was calm.
Calling the river 'at full tilt' adds a claim about its speed that the text does not give.
Amasai's words are definite, but the text does not say he felt no hesitation.
The passage says the men defected when David went to Ziklag, not that they came to Ziklag and got to work there.
The passage does not say the men stepped in right when David needed them.
The text says men came day after day, not that they came a few at a time.
The men were armed for battle, but the passage does not say they brought everything they had.
Papa calls the group 'my bakers' and asserts that they cannot agree on a topping. He addresses one baker at a time and does not call a baker his own.
The passage says relatives provided for them, but does not say someone back home packed and planned or identify love as the motive.
The passage does not say nobody went hungry at Hebron.
Joy is not literally the last word of the passage; the quoted sentence ends with 'Israel.'
